correctness.rationale: For the unfilled simplicial C10, an injective vertex filtration induces precisely a nonconstant acyclic binary orientation of its ten edges, and a vertex is matched when exactly one neighbor precedes it. Independently enumerating all 1022 nonconstant orientations gives 1021 distinct generating gradient matchings; downward closure has 6,480 nonempty faces with dimensions 0..7 counts (20,160,660,1520,2000,1470,560,90). The frozen checker separately enumerates 10! strict vertex orders to verify the orientation description. An independently reconstructed staged incidence-bit Morse matching gives 3,238 pairs, critical cells one 0-cell, one 4-cell, two 5-cells; all 31,840 nonempty Hasse edges topologically sort. The complete signed integral Morse matrix from degree 5 to 4 is [0,0], independently reconstructed by exact gradient-path arithmetic. Since the four-skeleton is S4 and pi4(S4)=Z, both 5-cell attaching maps are null. Hence full strong C10 complex is S4 wedge 2 S5; this is not a conclusion from its already known homology alone.
